[6:22PM] #Idumota #TrafficUpdate 

Idumota indicates a seamless flow of vehicular traffic inbound and outbound from Carter Bridge. 
The route beneath Idumota Bridge, leading to Eyin Eyo and subsequently connecting to Balogun Street, is witnessing movement in accordance with expectations. 
Conversely, the stretch from Tinubu Square to Nnamdi Azikiwe Street, enroute to Tom Jones intersection, is experiencing heightened activity due to the evening rush hour. 
Ilubinrin to Carter Bridge, proceeding towards Ijora Olopa, as well as Oyingbo, are characterized by expedited movement. 
The remaining areas under surveillance remain tranquil and devoid of impediments, thanks to the strategic deployment of traffic officers effectively managing the flow.

#FollowLASTMA

LOOK: The Bureau of Jail Management and Penology-Negros Island Region (BJMP-NIR) has designated Jail Senior Insp. Raymund Aro, as officer-in-charge of Negros Occidental District Jail (NODJ) in Barangay Tabunan, Bago City, replacing jail warden Jail Chief Insp. Crisyrel Awe, following the eight-hour protest of some Persons Deprived of Liberty (PDLs) over alleged unfair treatment in the facility on Thursday, according to Jail Senior Insp. Juniven Rey Umadhay, BJMP-NIR spokesperson.

Concurrently, Aro is the operations chief of BJMP-NIR. | Glazyl Masculino

📷 PRO-NIR

LOOK: Mr. Jeffrey Ng, Executive Vice President of the Federation of Filipino Chinese Chambers of Commerce and Industry, Inc. (FFCCCII), joined by FFCCCII officers, Quezon City Mayor Joy Belmonte, The Philippine Star President and CEO Miguel Belmonte, and other officials, led the distribution of relief goods to families and individuals affected by the recent typhoon and flooding. 

The humanitarian effort, held at Mabuhay Court, Barangay Tatalon, Quezon City, on August 28, 2025, was a joint initiative of FFCCCII, Philippine Star’s Operation Damayan, and the Quezon City local government. The activity underscores the strong collaboration between the public and private sectors in delivering immediate assistance to affected communities. 

📷: Contributed photos

[6:36PM] #Mile2 #TrafficUpdate 

Good movement from Ijesha to Mile 2, but a slow return journey to Oshodi due to evening rush. 
Traffic is smooth from Suru to Signal Barracks, but slow under Mile 2 bridge.
Meanwhile, Durbar to Festac, Agboju to Oluti, and Alakija areas are moving well, except for busy traffic around Alakija to Abule Ado and Apple Junction. 
Movement from Abule Ado to Agboju is good, but slow from Ecomog to Car Wash. Traffic officers are on ground managing the situation.

#FollowLASTMA
